fields.extract: the name as written, trimmed, abbreviations included ("Juan Hdz"). Do not add surnames.
the number as written, digits and a leading + only (remove spaces, dots, dashes, parentheses). Keep the country code only if the candidate wrote it.

`true` if they have a driving licence valid for a car or motorbike (any class: "carnet B", A2, "licencia tipo A", "licencia de motociclista"); `false` if they do not, including indirect answers ("no conduzco", "solo bici") and a licence that is not valid today: expired, being renewed, suspended or taken away ("la tengo vencida", "la estoy renovando", "me la quitaron"); `"in_progress"` if they are still getting it ("lo estoy sacando", "en trámite"), waiting for it, or have only a learner's permit ("permiso de aprendiz").

where they live or want to work now, as written, with obvious typos fixed ("Zapopan" for "zapopam") and aliases kept ("DF", "GDL", "MTY"). If they name a city and a zone, neighbourhood or colonia, give both, city first ("Sevilla, Triana"); if they name only a zone, give only the zone ("Gràcia", "Narvarte", without "la colonia"). Do not add a city they did not say. Always use the key `city`, never `location` or `zone`. A place they grew up in, come from, used to live in or are visiting is not their city ("I grew up in LA", "soy de Oaxaca pero vivo en Zapopan" → only "Zapopan"); with no current place, leave `city` out. If you can't tell whether a place is where they live now, give it with confidence below 0.7.

list of the periods they can work, from `morning`, `afternoon`, `evening` ("mañanas y tardes, noches no" → [`morning`, `afternoon`]); leave out a period they refuse. `flexible` alone when any period works ("cualquiera", "me da igual", "any" → [`flexible`]).

years of delivery or driving work as a number. Months divide by 12 ("medio año" 0.5, "6 meses" 0.5, "3 meses" 0.25, "un año y medio" 1.5). No experience ("ninguna") → 0. Add up periods on several platforms. If they are vague ("unos meses", "a while"), give a year or a range instead of an amount ("desde 2019", "entre 2 y 3 años"), or don't know or won't say ("no sé", "no me acuerdo"), give their words as a string: never work out a number from them, and never 0.

list from `glovo`, `uber_eats`, `just_eat`, `rappi`, `didi_food`, `deliveroo`, `amazon_flex`; anything else as the name they used (e.g. "Stuart"). "Didi" means `didi_food`, "Uber" means `uber_eats`. "Hice Glovo un año" gives both `platforms` and `experience_years`.

an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) resolved against today. "Ya", "hoy", "inmediato", "right away", "cuando sea" → today. "Mañana" → tomorrow. "El lunes", "next Monday" → the next Monday after today. "La semana que viene" / "next week" → the Monday of next week. "En dos semanas" → today + 14 days. "A principios de diciembre" → the 1st of that month. "El 15" → the next 15th of a month that is not in the past. A month alone ("en enero") → the 1st of its next occurrence. No resolvable date ("cuando acabe el curso") → leave it out.

fix_words.experience_years: experiencia|(?:numero de )?anos(?: de experiencia)?|experience|years(?: of experience)?
fix_words.start_date: fecha(?: de (?:inicio|incorporacion|comienzo|entrada))?|dia de inicio|cuando (?:empiezo|empezaria|puedo empezar|empiezo a trabajar)|start(?:ing)? date|when i (?:can )?start
fix_words.has_license: carnet(?: de conducir)?|licencia(?: de (?:conducir|manejo|manejar))?|permiso de conducir|(?:driving |driver s |drivers )?licen[cs]e

prompt_slots.tone: like a good shift manager talking to a new hire
prompt_slots.location_examples: "la sucursal de Benito Juárez", "el local de Madrid Centro", "our Madrid Centro location"
prompt_slots.concrete: a platform, how long, a vehicle
prompt_slots.confirm_value: `start_date`: read back `value` and ask if it is right. `city` with `location_id`: the place matched that location only loosely; ask whether they mean it, named as in the reference ("¿Te refieres al local de Gràcia?" / "¿Se refiere a la sucursal de Zapopan?"). `city` without it: `value` is a place outside our service areas, as the candidate named it; ask whether they currently live there ("¿Vives ahora en …?" / "¿Vive actualmente en …?"). Do not say they are out of the area yet. `experience_years`: `value` is years of experience; read them back and ask if that is right ("Para confirmar, ¿son 20 años de experiencia en reparto?"). With `platform`, ask instead how many years they have delivered with that platform ("¿Me confirmas cuántos años has repartido con Glovo?" / "¿Me confirma cuántos años ha repartido con Rappi?"), without the number. Never suggest you doubt them.
prompt_slots.country_words: Mexico (`MX`) "licencia de conducir", "celular", "sucursal"; Spain (`ES`) "carnet de conducir", "móvil", "local".
prompt_slots.short_answer: "sí" while the awaited field is `has_license` is `has_license: true`
prompt_slots.correction_example: "perdón, en realidad solo fines de semana"
prompt_slots.read_back: `has_license`: she asked whether they have no valid licence right now ("¿Entonces ahora no tienes carnet en vigor?"); agreeing that they have none ("sí", "no, no tengo") is `confirm` with no fields, and saying they do have one ("sí tengo", "no, sí lo tengo") is `correction` with `has_license: true`.
prompt_slots.follow_up_examples: "¿y en México también?" after she said what the pay is in Spain → "¿Cuánto se paga a los repartidores en México?"; "¿y eso cuánto es al mes?" after an hourly rate → "¿Cuánto se gana al mes?"; "¿y si es en moto propia?" after she answered about insurance → "¿Estoy asegurado si reparto con mi moto propia?"; "and on weekends?" after an answer about shifts → "Do I have to work weekends?".
prompt_slots.matrix_es: "puedo full time pero solo weekends en la mañana", "hice delivery para Rappi", "estoy ready para empezar el lunes", "me late el part time"
prompt_slots.matrix_en: "I live in Zapopan", "I live in la colonia Roma"
prompt_slots.mixed_example: "Tengo licencia, but I only work weekends"
prompt_slots.apology_example: "Perdona, llevo un día de perros. Tiempo completo y fines de semana" is `answer` with availability [full_time, weekends]
